speaker: Doctor
text: Do you recall any specific scary dreams or nightmares during these episodes, and has anyone noticed loud snoring or pauses in your breathing while you sleep? I would also like to check for enlarged tonsils or adenoids, so please open your mouth wide for me to look at your throat.
